verdict.rationale: AssemblyAI offers voice agents and an LLM Gateway, so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows AssemblyAI publishing its own Docs MCP server for coding agents, which is the server role. Nothing documents that AssemblyAI can connect to external MCP servers and call their tools.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
